school_choice: Public education money should go only to public schools.
Public money can follow students to public charter schools, but not private schools.
Public money should follow low-income students to any school, including private schools.
Public money should follow every student to any school their family chooses, including private schools.
charter_schools: There should be fewer charter schools; limit or close them.
There should be about as many charter schools as today.
There should be more charter schools.
There should be many more charter schools; any qualified group should be able to open one.
curriculum_control: Teachers and education experts should have the most say over what public schools teach.
State education boards should have the most say over what public schools teach.
Local elected school boards should have the most say over what public schools teach.
Parents should have the most say, with the right to review all teaching materials.
lesson_opt_out: Parents shouldn't be able to pull their children out of lessons; the curriculum is for all students.
Parents should be able to pull their children out of sex education only.
Parents should be able to pull their children out of any lesson that conflicts with their values.
teach_gender_identity: Public schools should teach about gender identity starting in elementary school.
Public schools should teach about gender identity only in middle and high school.
Public schools should teach about gender identity only in high school, and only if parents opt their child in.
Public schools shouldn't teach about gender identity at any grade.
sex_education: High school sex ed should fully cover contraception, consent and sexual orientation.
High school sex ed should cover contraception and consent while encouraging teens to wait.
High school sex ed should teach abstinence only.
High schools shouldn't teach sex ed; parents should.
student_loan_cancel: All existing federal student loan debt should be canceled.
Up to about $10,000 to $20,000 per borrower should be canceled.
Student debt should be canceled only for people misled by their schools, or after years of public service.
Federal student loan debt shouldn't be canceled.
loan_repayment: Student loan payments should be capped at 5% of income or less, with any remaining debt forgiven after 10 years.
Student loan payments should be capped at about 10% of income, with remaining debt forgiven after 20 to 25 years.
Borrowers should repay what they borrowed on standard terms, without income caps.
free_college: Public college tuition should be free for everyone, paid for by taxes.
Public college tuition should be free for families earning under about $125,000.
Only community college should be tuition-free.
education_department: The Department of Education should be expanded, with more federal school funding.
The Department of Education should stay about as it is.
The Department of Education should be shrunk, with money and control sent to states.
The Department of Education should be closed.
school_discipline: Schools should handle repeatedly disruptive or violent students with counseling and repairing harm, suspending only as a last resort.
Schools should use a mix of counseling and suspension.
Schools should suspend or expel repeatedly disruptive or violent students to protect other students.
selective_admissions: Selective public high schools should admit students by lottery among qualified applicants.
They should use grades and tests, plus seats for the top students from every middle school.
They should admit students by test and grades only.
legacy_admissions: Colleges that get federal money should be banned from favoring children of graduates or donors.
Colleges can favor children of graduates or donors, but must disclose it publicly.
Colleges should decide for themselves whether to favor children of graduates or donors.
